visualCharacteristics.purpose: content category filter for a listing
visualCharacteristics.description: Six small uppercase text tabs, left-aligned, no borders; active tab filled black with white text; each panel holds a 4-column card grid (the Nth following cards-adventure block is adopted into panel N).

contentPattern.structure: one row per tab: tab label | optional panel content; each panel's card grid is a separate cards-adventure block placed directly after this block, in tab order
